segments.name: Manufacturing
segments.description: Builds freight railcars, tank cars, intermodal and automotive railcars plus components, wheels, conversions and maintenance for railroads, shippers and leasing companies.
segments.evidence: The Manufacturing segment, which currently operates from facilities in the U.S., Mexico, Poland and Romania, produces double-stack intermodal railcars, tank cars, freight railcars, and automotive railcar products.

segments.name: Leasing & Fleet Management
segments.description: Owns and leases railcars and manages fleets for railroads, shippers, carriers, investors and other railcar owners in North America.
segments.evidence: We offer railcar management, regulatory compliance services and leasing services to railroads and other railcar owners in North America.

revenueModel.text: Railroads, shippers, leasing companies and financial institutions pay Greenbrier for new railcars, leasing, maintenance, component parts and fleet management services.
revenueModel.evidence: Our relationships with financial institutions and operating lessors combined with our ownership of a lease fleet of approximately 20,900 railcars enable us to offer flexible leases to our customers

changes.text: In 2025 Greenbrier changed the measurement basis for allocating revenue and expenses related to syndication activity between its two reportable segments.
changes.evidence: Effective September 1, 2025, we changed our measurement basis for allocating revenue and expenses associated with syndication activity between the Manufacturing and Leasing & Fleet Management reportable segments.
